top_choice_rationale: The collateral and financial-conditions contribution is the most mature and consequential proposal, with a defensible narrowly framed three-person attribution to the enduring analysis of macroeconomic amplification.
recusal_note: No candidate-specific conflict is apparent from the profile. I have coauthored with committee member Timo Boppart and have long professional connections with John Hassler, neither of whom is a proposed laureate.
